## 0.2.31

- Middle-click anywhere in the backpack sidebar, including occupied slots, empty slots, the header and frame, to sort the selected backpack contents.
- Support middle-click sorting in the storage area of right-click-opened ordinary and death backpacks. The player inventory remains a separate sort region; upgrade and crafting panels are excluded from the storage region.
- Resolve the current mouse position for the VanillaTweaks sort shortcut instead of relying on the previous frame's hovered slot.
- Preserve captured inner backpacks when sorting death-backpack contents, and retain matching-item deposits when sorting the player inventory.
- Remove extra selection text, control hints and page-number text from the wheel preview while retaining item icons, selection highlights and stack counts.

Minecraft 26.3 / Fabric; requires TotemCore 0.7.23. Install the update on both client and server.
